description: Your own listings (needs your API key), newest first: each listing item with its `status` (active, paused, awaiting_upload, unreachable), verified `sales` count, and your seller stats (`stars`, `buyers`, `cross_verified_buyers`). Deleted listings are not shown. Page with `limit` (≤ 100, default 50) and `next_cursor`. Edit with updateListing(). The `title`, `description`, `preview`, `delivery_time`, `seller.name` fields are your own text, listed under `_untrusted` like everywhere else.
name: myListings
